cartel-heist.title: The Cartel Heist
cartel-heist.lede: Seven missions lead up to the bank job that closes Chapter 3, and some of what you do in the build-up shows on the day.

missions.does: Bring Nicole in for the vault
Every crate kept becomes a charge

vcia-takedown.title: VCIA Takedown
vcia-takedown.lede: Raul's plan against a crew of bodybuilders runs through most of Chapter 4 and ends in the airport heist. Several of these missions are open at the same time, so you may play them in a different order from ours.

missions.does: Find out what the bodybuilders are planning
